DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

and egress-proxy rotation, with a fail-closed tool bridge and offline agent-scoped auditing."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Automatic model refresh**: fetches the free-model list at startup and every 10 minutes by defaul"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"t, adds/removes models as the upstream catalog changes, and retains the last successful list if a re"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"fresh fails.

- **Streaming and tool calls**: preserves r"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"easoning history across multi-step tool calls, adapts DSH's native tools, and rejects unverified con"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"versions rather than treating Bash commands as PowerShell.
- **Optional proxy failover**: configure "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"multiple HTTP(S) or SOCKS proxies, try another ready egress for explicit egress-quota errors or conn"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"ection failures, and respect server-requested waits."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install and get started"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Image input requires DSH's attachment request-version API; this version is built and verified agains"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"t DSH SDK 0.2.1-rc.2."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Install in DSH Desktop"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"1. Advanced "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"refresh-interval configuration is documented in the configuration reference."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Optional context trimming"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Open **Settings → OpenCode Bridge → Context trimming** to enable **Trim reasoning from completed tur"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ns**. Turn it off if continuity is affected."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Optional proxy setup"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Without proxy configuration, the plugin uses a direct connection from your machine."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. Open **Settings → OpenCode Bridge → Egress rotation (optional)**.
2. Add your existing proxy addr"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"esses one at a time, such as `http://127.0.0.1:7890` or `socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080`. You can keep `di"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"rect` (this machine) as an egress.
3. Use **Test all** to check connectivity. Cooling entries are sk"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ipped to avoid early requests. Adding or removing an entry saves and applies the change automaticall"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ped to avoid early requests. Adding or removing an entry saves and applies the change automatically."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The plugin prefers ready entries in list order. Explicit egress-quota errors or connection failures "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"temporarily cool an entry. A server-requested wait prevents immediate failover, and a fully cooling "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"pool sends no early requests. Model-backend unavailability and unexplained 429s are not automaticall"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"y treated as exhausted proxy quota."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"DSH centrally performs at most two automatic retries; excessive waits return an error for you to ret"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ry later. - **Third-party processing**: model"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" requests are sent to OpenCode's service and, when configured, traverse your proxy. Do not send cont"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"ent you would not entrust to those third parties.
- **Attachments**: image input follows each model'"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"s declared capability.
